note: Free-tier limits and alert thresholds for the independent usage monitor. Change a number here when a plan changes; nothing else is hard-coded. 'day' limits reset at 00:00 UTC, 'month' limits on the first of the month. Costs are never invented: a currency amount comes only from a provider that returns one.

predictive.note: linear projection of today's consumption to the end of the UTC day; only after 3 h have elapsed, and only as a prediction

costs.containment_note: Reaching the containment threshold does not limit billing and never switches off critical services or the distribution of rules that are already signed: it holds back only non-essential variable-cost operations (extra backups, expedited non-protective runs) and notifies. In this version it is reported and simulated; it changes nothing by itself.
